description: One notification to show (or to replace in place).

body.description: Body, already rendered in the app's language.

channel.description: messages, quiet, mentions or urgent (Android channel flare.<channel>).

collapseId.description:
Notification identity: one per conversation. Used as the iOS notification identifier and
the Android notification tag, so a later notification for the same conversation replaces it.

conversationId.description: Conversation the notification belongs to; empty for the digest notification.

count.description: Unread messages the notification stands for, at least 1.

messageId.description:
Server id of the newest message it stands for; empty for a catch-up without a loaded
message and for the digest notification.

seq.description: Conversation seq of the newest message it stands for; 0 for the digest notification.

sound.description: Whether to play a sound; a silent replacement never sounds.

surface.description: system (an OS notification) or inApp (a banner inside the running app).

threadId.description: Grouping key in the notification centre.

title.description: Title, already rendered in the app's language.

title: NotificationPresentation
